notes.title: Get Ready for Project Box at Steam's Lunar New Year Sale!
notes.notes:
Hello there! Project Box is about to participate in Steam's Lunar New Year Sale! come join this audio-visual feast and get a great value gaming experience.

Project Box is a 2D horizontal adventure puzzle game. With its unique art style, the game takes you into a dark fairy tale with a twist of horror, suspense and fantasy. You will learn an ugly secret hidden in the flat and see how a lonely child is swallowed by nightmares.

Event Period: From 10:00, Jan. 26, 2025 to 10:00, Feb. 9, 2025 (PT)
